Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at a rate λ(t), proportional to the number of infectious people I(t) = I1(t) + I2(t) and the transmission rate β.
Progression from the first to the second exposed stage at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the exposed state to the infectious state at a daily rate σ.
Progression from the first to the second infectious stage at a daily rate γ.

Name: π
Description: Susceptibility; the proportion of the population who is initially susceptible.

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate of the epidemic.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial observation model.

Name: p_ICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection.

Name: σ
Description: Rate of becoming infectious (progression through exposed stages).

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery (progression through infectious stages).

Name: µ_ICU|E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: σ^2_ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate at which new infections take place given a contact.
